Invalid selections:
- No administrative teacher: \(\binom{12}{3}=220\)
- All 3 from the same department: \(4\binom{4}{3}=16\)
- Intersection (all 3 from same grade department, no admin): \(3\binom{4}{3}=12\)

So invalid total:
\[
220+16-12=224
\]

Valid selections:
\[
\binom{16}{3}-224=560-224=336
\]

\[
\boxed{336}
\]
